name: Weekend z-favourite (5 coins)
description: On Saturdays and Sundays (UTC window open), buy the side spot is already >=1.5 sigma (15-min realised vol) past the strike at 6, 5 and 4 minutes before close, on SOL, ETH, BTC, XRP and DOGE; hold to settlement. Weekend books are thin and retail-driven, so late favourites are under-priced more than on weekdays.
hypothesis: sol-zfav's rule (unchanged) earns more on weekends: screen (next fills net of fee, z>=1.5, h 360/300/240, Jan-May / Jun-Aug) weekend +0.7..+1.9c vs weekday +0.3..+0.9c on all five coins, with Jun-Aug weekend BTC +1.7, ETH +1.9, SOL +1.2, XRP +1.4, DOGE +0.8. Losers: weekend quoters pricing off flat vol/last print. Wrong if pooled full CI includes 0, <60% months positive, 2x latency loses, or lockbox loses. Caveat: weekend split found by screening dev data (post hoc), and the weekday zfav lockbox edges were small.
